· A high level of attention to detail;

· An ability to follow grant application instructions to the letter;

· Strong memory for program details;

· Strong basic math skills to track constituents served and program impact;

· Strong writing skills;

· ability to quickly synthesize information;

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Strategic Project Manager \| Remote, United States \| Pax8**
=====================================================================

**Drive Strategic Transformation at the Centre of Pax8's Growth**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Join Pax8 as a Senior Strategic Project Manager and help shape the future of the world's leading AI and cloud marketplace for small and medium\-sized businesses. This is an opportunity to lead business\-critical initiatives that influence our global strategy, accelerate innovation, and create meaningful impact across the organisation. As Pax8 continues its AI journey, you'll work at the forefront of transformation while growing your own expertise alongside emerging technologies and industry\-leading talent.  

  



**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

You'll become part of our world\-class Strategy \& Operations team, partnering with leaders across the business to bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex strategic initiatives. This role offers visibility across the organisation and the opportunity to influence how Pax8 scales, evolves, and delivers exceptional outcomes for partners, vendors, and customers.


At Pax8, you'll work in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where ambitious ideas are encouraged and where innovation is embedded into how we operate.  

  



**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

Lead high\-impact strategic programmes and transformation initiatives from concept through delivery.


Build and maintain comprehensive project plans that align business priorities, timelines, resources, and outcomes.


Partner with executive stakeholders to ensure programmes remain focused on delivering measurable business value.


Create structure and governance frameworks that promote effective decision\-making and programme transparency.


Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and obstacles while proactively driving solutions.


Coordinate cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and accountability across multiple workstreams.


Monitor programme performance through metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.


Support organisational change efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, and ways of working.


Drive operational excellence by improving workflows, enhancing efficiency, and embedding best practices.


Ensure quality delivery while balancing stakeholder expectations, strategic priorities, and business objectives.  

  



**The Impact You'll Make**
--------------------------

Your work will directly influence Pax8's ability to execute strategic priorities, accelerate growth, and deliver transformational outcomes across the business. By bringing clarity to complexity and aligning teams around shared objectives, you'll help strengthen organisational performance and create long\-term value for our partners, customers, and employees.  

  



**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

We're looking for someone who brings:


✅ Extensive experience leading complex projects, programmes, or transformation initiatives in fast\-paced environments.


✅ Demonstrated consulting, strategy, operations, or business transformation experience.


✅ Strong expertise in programme governance, execution planning, stakeholder engagement, and business operations.


✅ Proven ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.


✅ Strong understanding of project delivery frameworks, including Agile, Scrum, Lean, Kanban, Design Thinking, and Waterfall approaches.


✅ Experience using project management platforms such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar tools.


✅ Exceptional problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, and decision\-making skills.


✅ Strong financial and budget management capabilities.


✅ Experience leading organisational change and driving successful adoption of new initiatives.


✅ Ability to build trusted relationships, navigate complexity, and deliver results through collaboration.


✅ A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.  

  



**Trust and Hiring**
--------------------

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.  

  



To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.  

  



We also use thoughtfully applied AI\-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.  

  



**Inclusion Matters**
---------------------

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.  

  



**Benefits**

**Compensation Range: $95,200 \- $136,000 (or more depending on experience)**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Competitive compensation package aligned to experience and market benchmarks.


* Annual bonus opportunity
* Equity participation through stock options
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage
* Dental and vision insurance
* Retirement saving

Karman is a fast\-growing energy technology company using distributed artificial intelligence (AI) to accelerate the clean energy transition and better serve utility customers. Utilidata’s distributed AI platform, powered by our custom NVIDIA chip, is transforming the way utility companies operate with real\-time visibility at the grid edge to better utilize customer energy resources, reduce power outages, and enable quicker storm recovery.

This individual will play a pivotal role in driving cross\-functional initiatives, ensuring the successful delivery of complex technical projects distributed across engineering work streams. Their time will be focused on managing team sprints, code reviews, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) cycles to ensure rapid progress and iteration. jobs.description:
**GI EMR Integration Project Manager**
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**  

  

Unio Health Partners (UHP) is a highly differentiated physician practice management platform with the goal of transforming care delivery across the Western United States. UHP partners with leading physician practices, creating a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture and facilitating best practice sharing across the platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broader suite of services, providing a meaningful benefit to both physicians and patients. UHP's best\-in\-class clinical program covers three sub\-specialties (urology, gastroenterology, and radiation oncology) and offers numerous ancillary services, including pathology lab, in\-office dispensing, and chronic care management. We are led by a highly accomplished management team and provide a full suite of management services to its affiliated practices. UHP is currently affiliated with 182 providers consisting of 119 physicians and 63 advanced practice providers operating out of 54 locations across Southern, Central, and Northern California.  

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The GI EMR Integration Project Manager is a temporary, six\-month role responsible for leading the Gastroenterology division's Athena EMR integration. The position will establish and manage the project plan, coordinate Clinical Applications and Operations, maintain accountability across workstreams, and provide clear reporting to leadership. The anticipated start date is as soon as possible.
**This is a remote position, and worker location must be within Unio Health Partners authorized states: AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IA, IL, MI, NV, NM, OH, OR, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA and WI**
  

**What you will be doing**
* Create and maintain a comprehensive project plan that defines scope, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, owners, and deadlines.
* Translate organizational and leadership priorities into actionable workplans with clear ownership, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Serve as the primary coordination point between Clinical Applications and Operations and promote timely decision\-making across all workstreams.
* Facilitate project meetings, document decisions and action items, and follow up with owners to ensure commitments are completed on schedule.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and open issues; identify risks early and escalate barriers requiring leadership support.
* Develop and drive corrective action plans when workstreams fall behind schedule or project risks threaten successful implementation.
* Prepare and distribute concise weekly status reports summarizing progress, upcoming milestones, decisions needed, risks, and action items.
* Provide regular project updates and reporting to executive and operational leadership.
* Support readiness, workflow alignment, testing, training coordination, implementation, and post\-go\-live stabilization activities as assigned.
* Maintain organized and accurate project documentation, including project plans, meeting notes, decision logs, risk logs, and status reports.
**What you will bring to the team**
* Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, project management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 3\-5 years of project management experience required
* Demonstrated project management experience, preferably involving healthcare operations, clinical systems, or EMR implementation and integration.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams and driving accountability among stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to develop detailed workplans, manage deadlines, anticipate risks, escalate issues appropriately, and communicate clearly with leaders and project teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management or collaboration tools; experience with Athena is preferred.
**Travel Requirements:**
Occasional travel to GI practice, administrative, or project locations may be required based on implementation needs.

jobs.title: Production & Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  

Comfrt is the \#1 Hoodie Brand in the U.S. the \#1 apparel brand \& \#1 blanket on TikTok globally. We create elevated basics designed to inspire mental well\-being, comfort, and confidence. With over 4 million hoodies sold in just two years, we're rapidly expanding across categories and markets including apparel, home, travel, accessory and beyond. We're seeking a highly skilled Production \& Project Manager to ensure flawless execution of our production processes and timely delivery of high\-quality products, as well as assist in follow up and execution on various projects.  

  

**About the Job:**  

The Production \& Project Manager will oversee the end\-to\-end production process across all product categories, ensuring speed, quality, and compliance. This role will manage global manufacturing partners and collaborate closely with Product Development, Technical Design, and Sourcing teams to uphold Comfrt's brand promise of comfort, quality, and speed\-to\-market.



Additionally, this role will partner with the Senior Director of Sourcing \& Supply Chain to manage coordination, and execution of strategic projects that drive business growth independent of day\-to\-day production activities.  

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Production Management**


* Own the management of full production cycle—from issuing vendor purchase orders to monitoring production flow through shipment—across all categories, ensuring alignment with launch calendars.
* Develop and maintain weekly WIP (Work in Progress) reports and production timelines. Anticipate potential issues, analyze root causes, and implement timely solutions.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with overseas vendors (China, Vietnam, Cambodia etc.), ensuring adherence to standards, timelines, and compliance. Conduct weekly check\-ins to address issues and provide guidance.
* Identify bottlenecks or delays early and implement proactive strategies to minimize risk.
* Partner with Product Development, Technical Design, and QA teams to ensure production meets design intent and quality standards.
* Ensure all production meets regulatory and sustainability requirements across U.S., EU, Canada, Australia, and other markets.
* Maintain accurate production documentation and provide visibility to leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* Drive process enhancements to improve accuracy, speed, efficiency, and scalability.
* Manage production across all categories: Apparel (Casual, Athleisure, Lounge, Outerwear…), Kids \& Pet Apparel, Home, Handbags, Luggage, and Accessories.


**Project Management \& Strategic Initiatives**


* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic supply chain related projects.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders across departments. Develop detailed project plans with clear milestones and resource allocations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workstreams. Facilitate regular project status meetings and provide executive dashboards to leadership.
* Identify and mitigate project risks proactively. Develop contingency plans and escalate critical issues with recommended solutions to the Senior Director.
* Drive adoption and implementation of new tools, processes, and systems. Provide training and change management support to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption.
* Serve as liaison between internal teams and external partners (vendors, consultants, technology providers) to ensure alignment and successful project delivery.


**Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of experience in apparel production management, with a proven ability to lead in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* 5\+ years of people management and cross\-functional team leadership experience.
* 3\+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated success in leading initiatives from conception through completion.
* Expert knowledge of apparel production processes, timelines, compliance standards across global markets, and product costing.
* Proven track record in managing overseas vendors and large\-scale, complex production operations.
* Advanced proficiency in analytical and data visualization tools (MS Excel, Google Sheets, pivot tables, PowerPoints, or similar BI tools).
* Strong proficiency in digital communication and collaboration tools (Slack, WhatsApp, Google Meet, Zoom etc).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a proactive, solutions\-driven mindset.
* Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail with strong follow\-through and accountability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to leadership and influence stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally for vendor visits, audits, and production oversight.


**Why Join Comfrt?**


* Be part of a purpose\-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company\-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.


*Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Upstart**


At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.


As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.


We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.


If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.


**The Team**
------------


Upstart’s Auto Retail team is bringing Upstart’s AI\-powered underwriting combined with best\-in\-class software to help all Americans get better access, lower rates and a better process when purchasing a vehicle. Auto lending represents over $600B in annual volume across over 70K dealerships and is used by almost every household in the country yet has record low process satisfaction, transparency, and credit access. We aim to change that. The team partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, Servicing, Fraud, dealer\-facing functions and more to improve the experience for lenders, dealers, and consumers.


As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own program planning, execution and outcomes for complex, high\-impact Auto Retail initiatives. You will turn ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder work into clear plans, drive decisions, manage dependencies and risks, and help teams deliver reliably and with quality. You will partner with Product Managers, who own product strategy and priorities, and Engineering Managers and engineers, who own technical design and implementation. * Analyzing problems and opportunities and developing clear, stack\-ranked recommendations
* Driving PM\-prioritized initiatives from technical planning through launch and rollout

-----------------------------


* Lead complex, cross\-functional software initiatives from alignment through delivery, coordinating across Product, Engineering, Servicing, Analytics, Machine Learning, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and dealer\-facing partners.
* Translate ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problem spaces into actionable plans with clear milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, and owners.
* Partner with Product Managers on business strategy and prioritization, and with Engineering Managers and engineering teams on technical approaches and execution plans.
* Engage meaningfully in technical discussions by evaluating software architecture, data models, data movement, data pipelines, and trade\-offs among potential approaches.
* Identify blockers, clarify ambiguous ownership, surface downstream impacts early, and help teams resolve issues before they create delivery risk.
* Establish practical, lightweight ways of working that improve coordination and visibility across teams without creating unnecessary reporting or process overhead.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* Professional experience in a Technical Program Management role, including ownership of complex, cross\-functional software initiatives.
* Experience translating ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems into executable plans with milestones, dependencies, risks, and clear ownership.
* Experience working in a TPM or similar role directly with product managers and engineering managers and their teams with a clear understanding of ownership, roles, and responsibilities.
* Technical fluency in software architecture, data models, third party vendor integrations, and data pipelines, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs among technical approaches.
* Experience delivering initiatives across Product and Engineering while connecting program execution to measurable business or customer outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience working in a complex industry, a multi\-sided marketplace, or B2B2C environment with competing stakeholders and priorities such as speed, quality, reliability, and scale.
* Experience partnering with teams in financial services, auto retail, servicing, fraud, analytics, Machine Learning, or other operationally complex domains.
* Experience establishing and scaling practical program\-management processes in an environment where ownership and ways of working are still evolving.
* Experience in a growth\-stage technology company or other environment where teams must move quickly while managing execution risk.

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Project Manager!  

  

Full\-time employee \- Remote  

Salary: $130,000 \- $140,000

**About Us:**


Capio Group is a California\-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010\. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. Capio Group is a small, but quickly growing firm that mixes good ideas, with great people, to achieve extraordinary results for our clients. We offer the salary and benefits of the bigger companies, with the added bonus of a flexible workplace and a great work\-life balance.  

  

**Scope of Work:**  

  

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Project Manager to work as part of a team on assisting with modernizing the client legacy systems by migrating to Salesforce and supporting integration efforts between legacy platforms and new technologies. The scope includes, but is not limited to, control cashier inventory management, vehicle registration, and integration to various legacy mainframe and Java applications within the enterprise. The Project Manager will help architect the solution, develop a detailed plan, and execute the transition to or with Salesforce. Additionally, will help with integrating legacy systems, including those built on Java, z/OS Connect, IBM Host Access Transformation Services (HATS), and other applicable technologies, ensuring seamless data flow and operational continuity. The Project Manager will be responsible for tasks including but not limited to:


1\. Solution Specifications Development* Develop detailed solution specifications and recommendations.

* Develop conceptual designs.
* Develop data models.
* Gather and document requirements for business process realignment.

* Write automated tests to validate code functionality and coverage.
* Complete development of system enhancements.
* Complete unit testing and document results in a Unit Testing Report.

* Provide defect fixes and resolutions for end\-to\-end (E2E) testing and document the results in an E2E Testing Report
* Provide defect remediation for other relevant test cycles.
* Complete user reports analysis, development, and/or conversion.


3\. Perform Project Management* Assess and update Master Project Management Plan.
* Perform Risk Management activities.
* Perform Schedule Management activities.
* Perform Communication Management activities.
* Manage Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
* Perform Cost Management activities.
* Create Project Reports.
* Enforce Change Control Processes.
* Perform Project Plan and Process Quality Assurance activities.
* Perform Project Management team activities, facilitate team communication, track progress and maintain project plan documentation.


4\. Analysis* Review the As\-Is architecture, analyze legacy systems, and deliver solutions for platform\-based architecture.

* Analyze current processes and deliver solutions for business process realignment.
* Analyze reports and provide architectural framework enhancements and defect fixes for data conversion efforts.


5\. Release Management and Deployment* Create a Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment pipeline.
* Create and manage release management processes.
* Build and align organization’s release calendar with external and internal customers.
* Prioritize and plan release build activities for critical defect fixes and product enhancements and publish production incident, release and resolution reports.


6\. Knowledge Transfer* Conduct knowledge sharing/mentoring sessions, walkthroughs including documentation.
* Develop training materials.
* Provide post\-go\-live defect triage and system monitoring activities.

* Submit monthly Knowledge Transfer Reports summarizing activities completed for the period.

7\. Post\-Implementation Support* Perform technical lead post\-implementation support for production issues and resolution.

jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!


**More about our team and company:**

  
**The Opportunity**
===================



We’re looking for a versatile Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who enjoys connecting the details to the bigger business picture. You’ll own sales compensation and tackle a range of other analytical and operational challenges that help Fleetio’s go\-to\-market teams perform at their best.



You’ll run the monthly commission process, maintain accurate plans, and help our teams understand and trust their payouts. Alongside that ownership, you’ll analyze performance trends, strengthen reporting, and improve the processes that support our revenue organization.



You might trace a commission discrepancy back to its source, investigate why conversion changed across a sales segment, or turn a manual workflow into a repeatable process using automation. You’ll identify problems, recommend solutions, and work with partners to implement those improvements.



This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives on variety, takes pride in precise execution, and wants to build both deep expertise and broad business understanding. You’re curious about how things work, comfortable learning unfamiliar processes, and motivated by making them better.



You’ll report to the Revenue Operations Manager and partner with Sales, Account Management, Finance, People Operations, Marketing, Enablement, and GTM Systems.


**Your impact**
===============



You’ll work across sales compensation, funnel analytics, and process improvement to help our revenue teams operate effectively and make informed decisions.


* Own the monthly sales commission process from data preparation and payout validation through handoff to Payroll, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity for our teams.
* Translate approved compensation plans into precise payout calculations and comp letters, seamlessly managing updates for new hires, role transitions, and plan changes.
* Resolve data and payout discrepancies by identifying root causes, clearly explaining findings, and maintaining records of adjustments.
* Lead investigative funnel analyses from exploration to practical recommendations, uncovering growth drivers and shaping the team’s focus.
* Empower sales leadership with a clear view of pipeline health, conversion velocity, and revenue attainment through high\-impact reports and executive dashboards.
* Collaborate across teams on territory design, capacity planning, and target\-setting, using data to evaluate options and trade\-offs.
* Streamline recurring workflows in partnership with systems and operational teams, leveraging AI to reduce manual effort and maintain high accuracy.
* Document processes and business rules to ensure scalability, repeatability, and strong cross\-functional trust.

**What you bring**
==================


* 4\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Compensation Operations, Finance, or a similar analytical role in B2B SaaS or a recurring\-revenue business.

* You’re comfortable asking questions and respectfully challenging assumptions when the data points elsewhere.
* You’ve owned a recurring process or project from start to finish and made it better along the way.
* You can take an open\-ended question, structure the analysis, check your assumptions, and land on a recommendation with clear trade\-offs.
* You have a proven track record of building and auditing spreadsheet models using formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and quality checks.
* You have hands\-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and QuotaPath (or similar commissions software).
* You learn unfamiliar areas quickly and can move between detailed operational work and broader business problems.

In this position, the Social Science Research Analyst will support federal staff with managing activities supported by the welfare and family self\-sufficiency research and evaluation portfolio. This portfolio is designed to expand knowledge about how Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) and other human services programs can best support the self\-sufficiency and economic well\-being of children and families with low incomes. Research, evaluation, data, and other activities within this portfolio advance the objectives of the statute authorizing this work and cover a range of topics including TANF policy and administration, evaluation capacity building within human services programs, employment attainment and retention, and knowledge building and communication. The portfolio includes experimental impact evaluations, implementation evaluations, descriptive research projects, research and data\-focused technical assistance projects, and other activities aimed at informing the design and implementation of programs.



In this position, the Social Science Research Analyst will use knowledge of TANF and other human services programs, research and evaluation methodology, data analysis, and statistics to assist federal staff in communicating with and monitoring the work of grantees and contractors; and coordinating research, evaluation, data\-related, and other activities.


**Responsibilities:**



* Support federal staff in managing research contracts and grants from award through project completion, report approval, and dissemination of findings, including:
	+ Reviewing contractor deliverables, such as reports, work plans, and analysis plans.
	+ Assisting with project management activities, including invoice review, timeline monitoring, action item tracking, and records management.
	+ Reviewing and processing grant actions, including performance progress reports, amendments, and noncompeting continuation applications.
* Monitor emerging research and trends relevant to ACF programs to:
	+ Support the integration of research findings into ongoing projects and strategic planning efforts.
	+ Identify emerging issues, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for future research, synthesis, and analysis.
* Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with OFA and ACF staff, leadership, program offices, and external stakeholders to ensure research, evaluation, and data activities align with program priorities and field needs.
* Facilitate the communication and dissemination of welfare and family self\-sufficiency research by:
	+ Providing written and verbal updates, coordinating meetings, preparing briefing materials and presentations, and participating in conferences and professional convenings.
	+ Fostering collaboration among grantees, contractors, researchers, and federal staff to promote the exchange of research findings, methodologies, and measurement approaches.
	+ Developing position papers, issue analyses, briefing materials, fact sheets, and other written products related to data, research findings, and program operations.
* Provide subject matter expertise to OFA and other ACF program offices in research methodology, data and policy analysis, performance management, program evaluation design and oversight, and applied research.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
 **Qualifications:**


* Demonstrated knowledge of policies and programs affecting children and families served by ACF programs, particularly TANF and other human services programs that seek to foster employment and economic well\-being among families with low incomes.
* Demonstrated knowledge of advanced social science statistical methods and techniques for assessing and improving the implementation and effectiveness of policies, programs, and interventions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with regard to (1\) critiquing empirical reports for technical accuracy and to improve clarity, and (2\) explaining complex evaluation, statistical, and data analysis methodologies and findings to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment, and be flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities.
* Strong organizational, time management, and project management skills, including handling multiple projects simultaneously and on tight timelines and appropriately prioritizing and tracking progress of assignments.
* Detail\-oriented and driven to produce high\-quality work.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams).
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
* U.S. Citizenship required

  


**Education and Experience:**


* Master’s degree in Child and Family Studies, Economics, Human Development, Psychology, Political Science, Public Health, Public Policy, Social Work, Sociology, or related fields required.
* Three (3\) or more years’ experience with program evaluation, research and evaluation designs, qualitative and/or quantitative data collection and analysis, and program performance measurement, with specific expertise in research, programs, and policies related to one or more focus areas within the welfare and family self\-sufficiency research and evaluation portfolio.

**Job Description**

The Chief Strategy Office is seeking a Research Analyst for its Office of Inclusive Planning (OIP). The Inclusive Planning team, under the Assistant Commissioner for Accessibility \& Equity, is dedicated to advancing transportation equity throughout NYC DOT’s programs and operations. OIP works to improve access to transportation for communities that experience barriers, including people with disabilities, older adults, low\-income New Yorkers, and people with limited English proficiency.
  

  

Reporting to the Data Lead, the Research Analyst will:
  

* Lead and support federally funded planning studies, including research activities, data collection, analysis, and development of project materials for the current Accessible Wayfinding for People with Disabilities study
* Support planning and research initiatives to better understand the needs, experiences, and priorities of communities that have historically experienced barriers to transportation.
* Support the management and communications for biannual Travel Surveys examining the travel habits, perspectives, and priorities of these communities.
* Support the Accessible Wayfinding for People with Disabilities study, including research activities, data collection, analysis, and development of project materials.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research and analysis to address questions related to transportation equity, accessibility, and other priorities identified by program leadership.
* Support data collection and evaluation efforts, including developing data collection instruments and coordinating logistics for surveys, interviews, and focus groups and developing inclusive strategies for public engagement.
* Analyze and synthesize research findings from multiple sources and translate them into clear, accessible insights.
* Create data visualizations, reports, presentations, and other materials and present findings at internal and external forums, as requested.

  

The selected candidate should have strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills and be able to work effectively with diverse stakeholders. The candidate should also demonstrate an understanding of planning and project delivery within City government.

1\. A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full\-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or

Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. Podcast Sales Strategy \& Solutions (PS3\) is the operational engine behind Spotify’s podcast advertising business. We work across sales, content, talent, and operations to bring podcast advertising to life — from ad formats and approvals to booking operations, sales enablement, and new show launches.


We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to own key podcast ad operations across The Ringer portfolio. You’ll connect Spotify’s sales organization with content, talent, and operations teams, keeping high\-volume approvals and booking workflows moving while helping our sales teams understand what can run, where, and when. You’ll be close to the full lifecycle of podcast advertising and help make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

* + Own Integrated Solutions approvals and vetting across The Ringer podcast portfolio, triaging incoming sponsorship requests, coordinating with the right partners, and tracking requests through resolution.
	+ Maintain a clear view of approvals across formats and shows, including what is approved, declined, pending, or escalated.
	+ Be a day\-to\-day partner to sales teams on approval timelines, show availability, booking logistics, and podcast advertising formats, and help resolve campaign\-specific blockers.
	+ Serve as a key connection between Spotify’s sales organization and The Ringer Studios Business Operations team, translating new formats, processes, and advertising products into clear operational plans.
	+ Manage The Ringer Podcast Booking Calendar, including inbound holds and bookings, new shows, editorial calendar updates, and post\-sale booking changes.
	+ Coordinate the PS3 workstream for new Ringer show launches, partnering across pricing, talent preferences, Creative Operations, sales enablement, and go\-to\-market readiness.
	+ Support new advertising format rollouts and maintain accurate sales resources, including show sheets, FAQs, format guidance, booking tools, and other enablement materials.
	+ Use campaign, booking, inventory, and revenue information to identify discrepancies, surface recurring questions, and improve how the team operates.
Who You Are


* + You have 4\+ years of experience in media operations, advertising operations, sales support, program management, or another coordination\-heavy environment.

	+ You bring a collaborative, adaptable approach and are comfortable pitching in across a small team with a broad remit. Experience with podcast advertising, digital audio, media sales operations, talent approvals, or The Ringer ecosystem can help you get up to speed quickly.
Where You'll Be


* + This role is based in Los Angeles or New York.

Learn about life at Spotify

DCAS's mission is to make city government work for all New Yorkers. From managing New York City’s most iconic courthouses and municipal buildings, to purchasing over $1 billion annually in goods and services for more than 80 City agencies what we do ensures that all agencies can deliver on their mission. Our reach touches every facet of city government and is instrumental to the successful day\-to\-day operations of the City of New York.
  

  

Our commitment to equity, effectiveness and sustainability guides our work providing City agencies with the critical resources and support needed to succeed, including:
  

  

* Recruiting, hiring, and training City employees.
* Managing 56 public buildings.
* Acquiring, selling, and leasing City property.
* Purchasing over $1 billion in goods and services for City agencies.
* Overseeing the greenest municipal vehicle fleet in the country.
* Leading the City's efforts to reduce carbon emissions from government operations.

  

When you work at DCAS, you're not just working for one agency, but in service of them all. It's an opportunity to provide impactful support, quality customer service, and help protect the future of New York City for generations to come. Visit our website at nyc.gov/dcas to learn more about the work we do.
  

  

DCAS’s Division of Energy Management (DEM) leads the City’s efforts to reduce carbon emissions from government operations. Our goals are to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 40 percent by 2025 (40x25\), 50 percent by 2030 (50x30\), and 80 percent by 2050 (80x50\). Additionally, DEM is tasked with completing work related to the City’s other energy\-related commitments, such as pledging to install 100 MW of solar photovoltaics on City buildings by 2025\. DEM works toward achieving the above goals by managing the City’s utility accounts, developing the City’s annual utility energy budget; helping our agency partners identify and pursue energy\-saving opportunities at their facilities; leading energy efficiency and distributed generation projects across the City’s portfolio; and helping implement operations and maintenance best practices.
  

  

The Senior Program Manager will be charged with responsibilities including, but not limited to, the following:

Some areas of focus will be identifying and implementing advanced preventative maintenance strategies on City buildings, as well as innovative software solutions to advance building automation based on BMS end point logged data, historical energy data, project data and various other metrics gathered at a building. The goal of the program will be to utilize advanced analytics to automate building operation in an effort to optimize operational and energy efficiency.
  

  

2\. Project Management Oversight \| Oversee and advise on the management of the Program’s portfolio of projects and opportunities, by providing technical expertise that focuses on HVAC mechanical and controls equipment and energy efficiency best practices, including development of energy conservation measure calculators.
  

  

3\. Program Support \| Lead program support efforts to help improve the efficiency of the program including: (1\) managing existing and future consultants to support the City’s building optimization efforts, (2\) developing solutions on how to scale the program, and (3\) guiding the development of annual program\-related metrics for reporting purposes.
  

  

4\. Team Management \| Supervising a team of 5\+ engineers, program administrators and analysts with a plan to more than double in size, upon success.
  

  

5\. Performance Management \| Drive and manage program success and growth by: (1\) developing and maintaining accurate and detailed program key performance indicator (“KPI”) metrics and (2\) advising on the recording of and providing strategic guidance on programmatic processes (e.g., the Program’s Standard Operating Procedure).
  

  

6\. Stakeholder Engagement \| Lead and facilitate correspondence with various stakeholders including agency energy personnel, executive leadership, innovative technology vendors.

jobs.title: Vendor Threat Mitigation Program Analyst - TS/SCI Clearance
jobs.description:
Join our Deloitte AI \& Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Project Lead Integration Engineer II on the project, provide critical Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) and Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) planning, coordination, and intelligence\-integration. The role ensures the security and resilience of the theater supply chain by identifying, assessing, and mitigating vendor\-related risks\-including foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI), cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial exploitation\-across the Area of Responsibility (AOR). The role is highly dynamic and adaptive to command priorities; requiring an experienced professional who can operate independently with minimal guidance.  

  

The VTM Program Analyst serves as a key contractor supporting Geographic Combatant Command (GCC) secure logistics objectives. The role focuses on the strategic planning of vendor threat assessments and supply chain illumination, aligned with the Theater Campaign Plan, Posture Plan, and Department of Defense (DoD) SCRM directives. A primary requirement is the ability to conduct high\-level risk framework analysis and all\-source intelligence reports, integrate them for mitigation actions into major joint operations, exercise support, and coalition logistics. As required, forward adversarial findings and reports to respective procurement contracting agencies and associated authorities to take direct action against vendor threats. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to successfully collaborate in multi\-echelon Joint Logistics and Intelligence Enterprises (JLEnt/JIE), are mandatory for success in this role.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* **Threat Analysis \& Illumination:** Conduct rigorous supply chain illuminations and vendor threat assessments to identify FOCI, cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial influence risks within the AOR, ensuring mission requirements are protected from compromised suppliers
* **Mitigation Planning:** Develop and implement theater\-specific VTM mitigation strategies and risk response plans, ensuring alignment with DoD security protocols and mission\-critical function protection
* **Exercise \& Operation Integration:** Support VTM planning for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Exercises (e.g., Balikatan, Cobra Gold), ensuring theater supply chains are modeled, stress\-tested against subversion, and assessed during major training events
* **Interagency \& Partner Sync:** Synchronize vendor threat intelligence and mitigation strategies with USFK, USFJ, SOCPAC, and regional Service Components. Coordinate with DCSA, DLA, and USTRANSCOM to ensure a unified theater defense
* **Governance \& Reporting**: Serve as a subject matter expert for VTM policy and governance. Draft formal staff products (EXSUMs, Info Papers) and deliver executive\-level briefings to General/Flag Officers (GO/FO) regarding theater supply chain vulnerabilities.
* **Doctrine \& Planning Proficiency:** Deeply understand and apply the following Joint Publications (JPs), DoD Directives and Instructions (DoDD/DoDI), and associated policies that support theater distribution security and vendor threat mitigation:
* + DoDD 5000\.01, The Defense Acquisition System: Mandates supply chain risk management, security, and resilience throughout the acquisition lifecycle and sustainment operations.
	+ DoDD 5240\.02, Counterintelligence (CI): Establishes foundational CI policy essential for identifying and mitigating foreign intelligence threats, FOCI, and espionage within the vendor base.
	+ DoDI 5200\.44: Protection of Mission Critical Functions to Achieve Trusted Systems and Networks (TSN).
	+ DoDI 4140\.01: DoD Supply Chain Materiel Management Policy (with focus on SCRM and resilience).
	+ DoDI 5000\.90: Cybersecurity for Acquisition Decision Authorities and Program Managers.
	+ JP 4\-0 / JP 4\-01: Joint Logistics and the Joint Deployment and Distribution Enterprise (JDDE).
	+ JP 4\-10, Operational Contract Support (OCS): Integration of commercial support into joint operations, including the assessment of vendor\-related risks to force protection and mission assurance.
	+ JP 2\-0 / JP 3\-0: Joint Intelligence and Joint Operations integration for threat\-informed logistics.
	+ NDAA Compliance: Specific expertise in Sections 889 (telecommunications) and 5949 (semiconductors) prohibitions within theater of operations.

  

**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

jobs.description:
**Part\-Time Project Manager – Diplomatic \& Cultural Programs**

**Du Plain Global Enterprises \| Washington, DC**

**Part\-Time \| Minimum 25 Hours per Week**

About Du Plain Global Enterprises

Du Plain Global Enterprises is a boutique public relations and cultural events company specializing in projects involving the diplomatic community in Washington, DC. We work with embassies, cultural institutions, government\-related organizations, and community partners to develop and support cultural programs, events, and special projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, responsive, technology\-comfortable Part\-Time Project Manager to oversee projects and coordinate a small team of associates and interns. The ideal candidate combines strong project management, communication, technology, and relationship\-building skills.

Key Responsibilities

· Manage and coordinate a small team of project associates and interns.

· Maintain project timelines, assignments, deadlines, and follow\-up.

· Create, update, and manage Google Sheets and Excel spreadsheets.

· Use Google Workspace, Zoom, Excel, AI tools, and other technology platforms to organize and execute projects efficiently.

· Make professional outreach and follow\-up calls to embassies, diplomatic offices, cultural organizations, partners, and participants.

· Maintain organized contact lists, project databases, and outreach records.

· Schedule and coordinate Zoom meetings and prepare agendas and briefing materials in advance.

· Participate in Zoom meetings, take accurate notes, and prepare concise meeting summaries, action items, and follow\-up assignments.

· Attend cultural, diplomatic, and professional events as a representative of Du Plain Global Enterprises and its projects.

· Communicate professionally with ambassadors, embassy staff, cultural attachés, event partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

· Gather information and materials from the project team and outside partners.

· Prepare professional final project reports, summaries, presentations, and supporting documentation.

· Identify issues, missing information, and outstanding tasks before deadlines and ensure that assignments do not fall through the cracks.

Ideal Candidate

· Exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, reliable, and able to manage multiple assignments at the same time.

· Confident speaking with people by telephone and in person.

· Professional and comfortable interacting with embassy officials, executives, cultural organizations, and senior\-level contacts.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Comfortable using technology, including Google Sheets, Google Docs, Excel, Zoom, Google Drive, and AI productivity tools.

· Able to supervise and follow up with associates to ensure assignments are completed.

· Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable solving problems independently.

· Able to work effectively in a fast\-moving, deadline\-driven environment.

Communication \& Responsiveness Are Essential

**This position requires very strong telephone and digital communication skills.** Candidates must be comfortable making professional phone calls, answering their phone during agreed working hours, returning missed calls promptly, and responding quickly to texts, emails, and project messages.

**If you are uncomfortable making phone calls, communicating frequently by phone, or responding promptly to calls and messages, please do not apply.**

Schedule

· Part\-time position.

· Required commitment of approximately 25 hours per week.

· Some evening events, receptions, or special programs may occasionally be required.

· Schedule may vary depending on active projects and event calendars.

Preferred Background

· Project management

· Public relations

· Events

· International relations or cultural affairs

· Hospitality

· Communications

· Business administration

· Embassy or diplomatic community work

· Nonprofit or association management

Compensation \& Engagement StructureThis is a **part\-time consulting/project\-based position** rather than a traditional full\-time corporate management role. Compensation is **moderate and commensurate with the scope of the position, experience, and approximately 25 hours per week of expected involvement**.

How to Apply

Please email your resume and a brief introduction explaining your interest in the position to:

**janduplain@gmail.com**

**Copy: monia.zgarni@gmail.com**

**Email subject:** Project Manager – Du Plain

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20001

----------------

* Must be a US Citizen.
* Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
* Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
* New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E\-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E\-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e\-verify.gov
* Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326\.
* Males born after 12\-31\-59 must be registered for Selective Service.

* This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.

### **Qualifications**


Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the NH\-02 pay band (GS\-11 grade level equivalent) in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: **Managing the strategic workforce and recruitment operations of sensitive corporate personnel programs, policy compliance audits, and management\-employee relations to optimize talent acquisition, safeguard sensitive information, and ensure total regulatory alignment within a corporate\-level operations group.**  

  

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website:https://www.opm.gov/policy\-data\-oversight/classification\-qualifications/general\-schedule\-qualification\-standards/0300/management\-and\-program\-analysis\-series\-0343/

This job does not have an education qualification requirement.

**This announcement uses the AcqDemo Business \& Technical Mgmt direct hire authority to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service.**

This position is covered by the Department of Defense Priority Placement Program.

* Establish consistent project management practices, tools, and templates for tracking deliverables, action items, and documentation across the team.
* Guide the Project Coordinator and support staff in managing logistics, stakeholder communications, and project records through closeout.
* Capture lessons learned and performance insights from completed projects to stren

Bachelor's degree (4\-year).


* At least eight (8\) years of technical experience, including at least four (4\) years of project management experience providing services to organization management and technical staff, including:
	+ supporting complex Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) efforts and managing complex, multimillion\-dollar projects in accordance with Federal laws, regulations, and procedures.
* Working knowledge of project management best practices, such as PMI's Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK).
* Current PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience with staffing, scheduling, and client interaction.
* Availability during PWS Core Hours and ability to work on\-site in Rockville, MD.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an HHS background investigation and PIV card.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level clearance.


**Desired Qualifications:**


* Understanding of Six Sigma and Agile methodologies (desired, not required, per PWS).

Technical Project Manager to support TSA programs. The role supports nationwide reporting, requirements, and agile delivery. Work may be remote or onsite in the National Capital Region, with occasional client meetings as required. This position is contingent on contract award.

What You Will Do

* Build and maintain nationwide business intelligence reporting in Power BI.
* Work with government stakeholders to document business and technical requirements.
* Turn requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and business process models.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other Scrum ceremonies.
* Maintain and prioritize the product backlog in Jira.
* Coordinate government, technical, and vendor teams to keep delivery on schedule.
* Validate workflows through system modeling and end\-user testing.
* Track risks, actions, decisions, and status for government leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Business Information Technology, or an equivalent field.
* Five or more years managing technical or IT projects, including federal program support.
* Experience supporting a federal transportation security or homeland security organization.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Program Manager**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Training Systems and Simulation Program Management Office (PMO) in the development, delivery, operation, and maintenance of all F\-35 training systems, to include all Pilot Training Devices, Maintenance Training Devices, and the Joint Simulation


Environment. The F\-35 Training Systems are critical enablers to producing Mission Qualified Pilots and Maintainers while tracking their training status throughout the individuals’ career. They are comprised of the Hardware, Software, subsystems, equipment, and reference data required to design, develop, deliver, evaluate, and refine the training provided to F\-35 personnel with the necessary capacity and fidelity to enable aircrews to train to the high\-end fight.

  

You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who work closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.

  



**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security clearance.**


In this role you will:


* Pilot and Maintenance Training Devices – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in overseeing the development and delivery of all Pilot Training Devices and Maintenance Training Devices, and in exploring future technology solutions that could potentially resolve existing technology limits within the training systems.
* Pilot and Maintenance Training Courseware – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in producing the courseware used for classroom training as a supplement to the Pilot and Maintenance Training Devices.
* Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in managing three subsystems as part of the LVC architecture.
* Verification and Validation – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in performing verification and validation as part of the development and acceptance of the Training Products (devices, courseware, training aids, etc.) prior to delivery to the customer.
* TSS PMO Acquisition Cell and Joint Simulation Environment (JSE) Acquisition Support – Facilitate contract actions from requirements gathering through contract award. Recommend contract strategies. Lead
* IPT/stakeholders through Request for Proposal (RFP) package development and Proposal Evaluation. Communicate TSS PMO needs with the prime contractor. Review and evaluate both RFP and proposal information and make recommendations to the team. Ensure teams meet deadlines to reduce contract lead times. Organize, record and track contract information changes and communications between contractors and the TSS PMO team. Create products and presentations that present information logically and increase team knowledge. Ensure contract status is updated weekly.
* Assist with task support of acquisitions, financial management, risk management, systems engineering, total ownership cost determination, acquisition coordination, and communications.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) located at Crystal City, VA, a minimum of 3 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or related discipline.
	+ OR an Associate’s degree plus 4 years of additional work experience (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Experience in program management, technical or business analysis discipline, in weapon systems acquisition and life cycle management
* A minimum of 4 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to analysis and planning.
* At least 2 years in support of a Major Defense Acquisition Program (MDAP).
* Leadership experience in US Service\-related military operations or defense acquisition program management related to weapons system acquisition, employment and life cycle management.
* Knowledge in DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000\.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - TS/SCI
jobs.description:
Spry Methods is seeking a Technical Program Manager to provide leadership and technical oversight for personnel supporting cyber intelligence analysis, operational enablement, and related mission activities. The Technical Lead will assign work, supervise technical efforts, manage team performance, and ensure the quality and efficiency of contract performance. This position will support intelligence collection, all\-source cyber analysis, analytical production, knowledge management, technology integration, external engagement, and cyber operations. The Technical Lead will also support applicable financial and business processes while avoiding inherently governmental functions. Occasional CONUS and OCONUS travel is required



### **What Your Day\-To\-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities):**


* Provide leadership and technical guidance to personnel supporting mission activities.
* Assign tasks, supervise ongoing technical efforts, and manage overall team performance.
* Ensure analytical products and technical deliverables are accurate, complete, objective, timely, and compliant with quality standards.
* Oversee all\-source cyber analysis supporting law enforcement, counterintelligence investigations, and cyber operations.
* Guide the development of intelligence requirements and methodologies for collecting, analyzing, managing, and presenting intelligence.
* Support the production and quality review of serialized intelligence products, operational cyber threat products, Intelligence Information Reports, cyber intelligence reports, operational lead reports, and related analytical products.
* Coordinate intelligence analysis and operational planning with Government personnel, intelligence analysts, and mission partners.
* Support intelligence collection and analysis using multiple intelligence disciplines, including HUMINT and SIGINT methodologies.
* Lead technical exchanges, working groups, liaison activities, and information\-sharing efforts with mission partners.
* Manage technical project scope, schedules, resources, costs, risks, and performance.
* Support requirements and capability assessments, production metrics, executive briefings, and actionable recommendations.
* Coordinate rapid technical and analytical support for emerging cyber mission requirements.
* Assist with applicable financial and business processes without performing inherently governmental functions.
* Travel occasionally to CONUS and OCONUS locations.
### **What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements):**


* TS/SCI clearance eligibility.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years leading technical efforts or supervising teams supporting intelligence analysis requirements.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years supporting the Intelligence Community or related Government, industry, or academic organizations in intelligence collection, policy, systems, and capabilities.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years applying intelligence analysis principles, concepts, and methodologies, including HUMINT and SIGINT methods.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years developing requirements and methodologies to collect, analyze, manage, and present intelligence in support of cyber investigations and operations.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years producing analytical reports, including Intelligence Information Reports, serialized intelligence products, and operational cyber threat products.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years managing project scope, cost, resources, risk, and schedule.
### **Ideally, You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications):**


* Experience supporting DoW law enforcement, counterintelligence, or cyber operations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary intelligence and technical teams.
* Experience reviewing serialized intelligence and all\-source cyber products for quality and compliance.
* Experience coordinating with Intelligence Community, law enforcement, counterintelligence, and interagency mission partners.
* Familiarity with cyber threat intelligence, intelligence collection management, technical capability assessments, and operational planning.
$200,000 \- $210,000 a year
Final compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, certifications, clearance level, and contract requirements. This position is contingent upon contract award.

jobs.title: Logistics Security Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


The Logistics Security Intelligence Analyst supports Micron’s global logistics security program by producing timely, actionable intelligence on shipment risk, cargo theft trends, route exposure, carrier performance, alert activity, and logistics security incidents. This individual contributor role helps strengthen shipment visibility, support incident response, and enable data\-driven decisions for valuable and sensitive shipments across Micron’s transportation network.  



  

**Responsibilities:**

* Collect, analyze, and report on logistics security data related to high\-value and high\-risk shipments, including shipment value, route risk, carrier performance, tracking status, alert activity, and incident history.
* Monitor internal, vendor, industry, open\-source, and law\-enforcement sources for cargo theft trends, route disruptions, regional security developments, and emerging threats.
* Prepare intelligence summaries, dashboards, route profiles, regional threat updates, incident trend reports, and briefing materials for logistics security leaders and multi\-functional collaborators.
* Support lane, route, carrier, provider, and regional risk assessments by identifying risk indicators, documenting findings, and helping translate analysis into practical control recommendations.
* Analyze shipment monitoring alerts such as route deviation, unauthorized stop, signal loss, seal breach, geofence violation, cargo separation, and other logistics security events.
* Support blocking issue and incident response activities by validating information, compiling shipment and carrier details, maintaining incident timelines, and contributing to after\-action reviews.
* Maintain structured records of incidents, near misses, alerts, carrier exceptions, recovery outcomes, false positives, device failures, and corrective actions to support program metrics and continuous improvement.
* Assist with logistics security playbooks, standard operating procedures, reporting templates, risk assessment criteria, audit support materials, and governance documentation.
* Use data analytics, AI\-enabled tools, mapping resources, shipment visibility platforms, and intelligence databases to support efficient, well\-governed logistics risk analysis.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Security, Risk Management, Business, Data Analytics, Intelligence Studies, or a related field.
* Experience supporting logistics security, transportation risk, supply chain risk, intelligence analysis, investigations, or related risk management functions.
* Collect, analyze, and synthesize operational, security, shipment, carrier, and incident data to identify trends and support decision\-making.
* Solid understanding of logistics operations, transportation networks, cargo movement, carrier management, supply chain security, and data visualization/reporting tools.
* Prepare business\-focused reports and risk assessments, collaborate across functions, and manage sensitive logistics and security information with discretion.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in supply chain security, logistics, intelligence analysis, risk management, or related disciplines, with relevant certifications/training (e.g., TAPA, CTPAT).
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess and communicate logistics security risks in clear business terms.
* Diligent with the ability to maintain accurate records, reports, documentation, and timelines in fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environments.
* Collaborate with multi\-functional teams, logistics partners, carriers, security vendors, and internal collaborators.
* Demonstrated sound judgment, confidentiality, and proficiency with AI\-enabled, data\-driven, and automation tools to improve analysis, reporting, and decision\-making.
