jobs.description:
**Description**


**Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?**

  

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. The Leidos Intelligence Sector combines technology\-enabled services and mission software capabilities in the areas of cyber, logistics, security operations, and decision analytics to support our defense and intel customers’ mission to defend against evolving threats around the world.

 **Your greatest work is ahead!**

  

The Intelligence Sector seeks a highly qualified and trained Journeyman\-level Cyberspace Intelligence Threat Analysts to support United States Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM) operations, with focus on identifying, analyzing, and recommending mitigation strategies for Cyber threats targeting Offensive Cyberspace Operations (OCO) systems. This vital on\-site support to USCYBERCOM J3 (Operations), Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF), and Joint Task Force\-Ares (JTF\-ARES) underpins USCYBERCOM support to United States National Security objectives.

  

This opportunity is in anticipation of a potential future contract award.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Provide timely, accurate, relevant support in manner that best supports USCYBERCOM in identifying and assessing emerging threats and vulnerabilities in the Cyberspace domain, with focus on risks to OCO systems.
* Analyze and evaluate All\-Source finished intelligence, single\-source intelligence, and technical data from various sources to identify Cyber threat patterns and anomalies.
* Produce and deliver recurring threat intelligence reports, summarizing relevant cyber threats to OCO infrastructure.
* Conduct and publish in\-depth risk assessments to evaluate and categorize the risk posture of detected cyber threats while supporting development and refinement of risk assessment methodologies and tools used for threat categorization.
* Utilize Signals Intelligence (SIGINT) tools and apply analytical methodologies when required to perform technical analysis on critical Cyber threats impacting OCO assets.
* Collaborate with operational, technical, and intelligence elements across USCYBERCOM to enhance situational awareness and threat response capabilities.
* Maintain a current understanding of advanced persistent threats (APTs), threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and cyber threat trends affecting national security.
* Maintain situational awareness of, and execute on demand, Cyberspace Operations (CO) crisis plans.
* Provide situational awareness to a range of projects, Crisis Action Teams, and current operations activities supporting Operational Planning Teams (OPTs).
* Execute resource allocation decisions aligned with organization objectives.
* Apply knowledge of cyber threats and attack methods and techniques emanating from state and non\-state adversaries and tiered vulnerabilities within Blue Space as focus of threats.
* Develop and execute comprehensive programs for assessing CO and validating operational performance characteristics.
* Review, approve, prioritize, and submit operational requirements for research, development, and/or acquisition of cyber capabilities.
* Support integration and synchronization of intelligence planning activities with operational planning timelines.
* Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, and guidance relevant to daily activities.
* Communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well\-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

 **What does Leidos need from me?**

* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and Polygraph required.
* BA/BS degree or higher within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Intelligence Studies, or related field, or ability to complete degree within one year of hire. Can substitute formal education with extended experience and technical certifications.
* Five plus years’ experience within Cyber intelligence analysis or a similar Cyber threat analyst role, or eight plus years’ total within field of intelligence analysis.
* Demonstrated understanding of All\-Source intelligence principles as applied to field of Cyber.
* Demonstrated experience with applicable SIGINT tools and techniques and able to produce single\-source intelligence products tailored to drive CO.
* Broad knowledge of Blue\-space Cyber capabilities and demonstrate understanding of available Cyber infrastructure or platforms to conduct Defensive (DCO) and Offensive Cyberspace Operations (OCO).
* Knowledge of the range of CO and their underlying intelligence support needs, topics, and focus areas.
* Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as well as concepts, terminology, and operations of a wide range of communications media (computer and telephone networks, satellite, fiber, wireless).
* Ability to support timely, accurate, relevant analytical production, to include documents, summaries, issue papers, talking points, and briefings
* Demonstrated proficiency working in a fast\-paced collaborative environment, ability to proactively multi\-task and meet short deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal, critical thinking, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex and technical data to non\-technical consumers.

 **Favorable if you have:**

* Masters’ Degree or higher within Cybersecurity, Intelligence Studies, Information Security or related fields.
* Intimate familiarity with USCYBERCOM organizational structure and mission.
* Prior experience supporting Joint operations across multiple warfighting domains.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning into operations at any level to increase efficiency and effectiveness of operational outcomes

jobs.description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


As the Logistics Security Program Manager for EMEA, this role is an essential part of Micron’s Global Security team. The person leads the management and continuous refinement of the company’s important logistics security efforts across the EMEA area. This position serves as the regional authority, advancing risk\-focused security methods that protect high\-value shipments, improve supply chain durability, and lower transportation security risks in intricate multimodal logistics networks.

  

As a senior individual contributor, the Logistics Security Program Manager takes charge of regional program initiatives on their own. They apply solid judgment to shifting threat conditions and collaborate with colleagues across functions and external partners to produce security results. The position involves balancing security, operational efficiency, and business continuity while transforming regional risks into scalable, practical controls that advance cargo visibility, shipment protection, and incident readiness.

* Act as the EMEA logistics security authority, guiding the creation and implementation of risk\-focused security programs for valuable and sensitive shipments involving carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers.

* Develop and maintain logistics security policies, standards, playbooks, governance frameworks, and audit criteria aligned with industry guidelines such as TAPA FSR/TSR.
* Prepare executive\-level briefings, risk assessments, incident summaries, supplier scorecards, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision\-making and measurable program improvements.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, Risk Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Extensive experience managing logistics security, transportation risk, cargo protection, and supply chain security initiatives throughout EMEA, with a proven history as a senior individual contributor advancing regional implementation and operational excellence.
* Strong experience in establishing and maintaining shipment security protocols, including cargo tracking, telematics, geofencing, route management, escorts, smart seals, monitoring, incident response, and recovery operations.
* Verified experience in examining route, carrier, facility, and provider risks; analyzing security and performance information; and formulating actionable controls that reinforce security while sustaining operational continuity.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and collaborator management skills, partnering with carriers, 3PLs, suppliers, security vendors, and internal teams to align on security objectives, manage vendor performance, and deliver executive\-level recommendations and incident communications.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience and/or professional certifications in supply chain security, risk management, logistics, or related areas preferred.
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex logistics and security risks into clear, actionable business recommendations for diverse collaborators.
* Demonstrated capability to guide through fast\-paced, rapidly evolving situations by applying good judgment, analytical reasoning, and risk\-informed decision\-making.
* Proficient in developing positive interactions across internal teams, carriers, 3PLs, and external providers while encouraging security outcomes through influence and accountability.

jobs.title: Tech Infra Program Manager, DC Power Utilization Management
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About the Role  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to join the Power \& Utilization Management and Planning (PUMP) team within AWS Infrastructure Services. This role is responsible for driving programs that maximize power capacity, improve position planning accuracy, and accelerate rack deployment across AWS's global fleet of data centers.  

  

What You'll Do  

  

As a TIPM on the PUMP team, you will own sub\-workstreams within one or more of the following program areas, working under the guidance of senior TIPMs who hold end\-to\-end accountability. You will drive execution on defined scopes, remove blockers, coordinate across partner teams, and progressively take on broader ownership as you build domain expertise.  

  

Data Center Position Configuration \& Automation
  

  

The Soapstone workflow produces three interdependent datasets per build — rack placement on the floor plan, power circuit\-to\-rack mapping (which determines what whips get physically installed), and network cabling plans (which determine how server racks connect to aggregation racks). These outputs determine what gets physically built: general contractors install whips from them, electrical engineers configure three\-phase power equipment at the rack level, and mechanical engineers reference them for downstream work. When this workflow is delayed or incorrect, construction stalls, hardware ships to positions that cannot support it, and capacity delivery slips. You will own sub\-workstreams within this pipeline — for example, driving configuration for a set of availability zones, managing the intake and validation process through SLATE (the team's build coordination portal), or accelerating Hamlet automation coverage to new building classes (COLO sites, hybrid floor plans, Room 1 configurations).  

  

Power Reclamation \& Infrastructure Upgrades
  

  

You will drive specific remediation campaigns that recover stranded power across legacy data centers through electrical upgrades, PDC (Power Distribution Cabinet) deployments, cooling improvements, and breaker\-level optimizations. The power distribution landscape is complex: four distinct PDC versions are active in the fleet with different breaker counts and ampacity ratings, whip counts range from 18 to 26 per rack depending on product type, and whip lengths are tracked manually in Excel files rather than any system of record. You will coordinate across Field Remediation Engineering (FRE), Construction Project Implementation (CPI), Colocation Regional Engineering (CRE), and equipment procurement teams to execute physical infrastructure changes on time.  

  

Network \& Server Position Planning
  

  

You will own sub\-workstreams that improve how network and server positions are planned, allocated, and made ready for deployment. A key challenge is that every rack product connects to the network differently — connection protocols vary (RoCE vs. EFA), server\-to\-switch ratios vary (3:1, 2:1, 1:1\), and switch rack generations keep evolving (12\.8T, 51\.2T, 102\.4T Ultra). You will work with Fulfillment Planning (FP), Capacity Delivery Planning (CDP), and Global Network Deployment (GND) on initiatives like the Fungible Network program, which deploys a standard product\-agnostic network footprint per ROMP so that product flips no longer require cabling rework. You will use and improve tools like RATS and PRP to increase allocation rates and reduce rejection rates at scale.  

  

Power Data Modeling \& Metrics
  

  

You will contribute to the development and maintenance of power\-related data models, dashboards, and sources of truth that inform executive\-level decisions on capacity investment, utilization targets, and demand planning. This includes working with data engineering and BI teams to build QuickSight dashboards, validate Power SOT (Source of Truth) data, and support Monthly and Weekly Business Reviews.  

  

Utility Power Management
  

  

You will support programs that optimize utility power utilization to meet contractual obligations and avoid financial penalties. This includes monitoring site\-level deployed load against contracted capacity, identifying sites at risk of under\-utilization, and coordinating with energy and operations teams to improve utilization rates.  

  

Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management
  

  

You will work daily with 10\+ partner organizations including CDP, CRE, CPI, FRE, DCEO, GND, Hardware Engineering, ML Planning, AISS Science, and Networking. Success in this role requires the ability to influence without authority, drive accountability across organizational boundaries, and escalate effectively when blockers arise.  

  

About the team  

The PUMP team sits at the intersection of data center engineering, supply chain operations, and capacity planning. We own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of how power is planned, configured, allocated, and utilized across thousands of lineups, hundreds of data centers, and dozens of clusters worldwide. Our decisions directly impact AWS's ability to deliver compute, storage, and machine learning capacity to customers — from core EC2 workloads to the latest GPU\-accelerated ML platforms like GB300, VR200, and TRN3Max.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
* Experience communicating and handling cross\-functional programs including project stakeholders, technical program managers, and software development teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in data center, networking engineering, systems engineering or construction management with a good unders

*

jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong Retail and Hospitality sector experience to support business transformation, technology implementation and data lead change initiatives across a drinks/restaurant\-led retail and pub/hospitality environment. The successful candidate will combine strong Business Analysis and consultancy capability with practical experience working with retail and/or pub and hospitality operations. Together with experience of cloud migration, data platform transformations. They will work closely with business stakeholders, operational teams and technology delivery teams to understand business needs, analyse current processes, identify opportunities for improvement and translate business requirements into effective technology and process solutions. The role will have particular focus on Point of Sale (POS), Product Information Management (PIM), inventory and supply chain, CRM, cloud platforms and associated retail and hospitality systems. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong consultancy and interpersonal skills, with the ability to understand underlying business problems, challenge assumptions constructively, influence and facilitate stakeholders, understand the practical realities of retail and hospitality operations, develop pragmatic recommendations and translate business needs into effective technology and process change.
Responsibilities:
* **Business Analysis \& Consultancy**
	+ Act as a trusted Business Analyst and consultant to business and operational stakeholders.
	+ Lead workshops, interviews, process analysis and requirements elicitation across retail and hospitality operations.
	+ Analyse business problems and challenge existing processes and assumptions to identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation and improvement.
	+ Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process models and actionable recommendations.
	+ Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, technology teams, Product Owners and delivery teams.
* **Retail \& Hospitality Operations**
	+ Apply practical knowledge of pub, hospitality, drinks retail and/or licensed retail operations to support business change and transformation initiatives.
	+ Understand operational processes including sales, ordering, stock management, replenishment, promotions, pricing, product management, supplier management and customer engagement.
	+ Analyse the impact of proposed changes across pubs, stores, branches, central functions and operational teams.
	+ Identify operational inefficiencies, manual processes, duplication and opportunities for automation and digital enablement.
	+ Understand the relationship between front\-of\-house operations, back\-office processes, supply chain and corporate functions.
* **Retail Platforms, POS, PIM \& Supply Chain**
	+ Analyse and define requirements for POS, PIM, inventory and supply chain systems and their supporting business processes.
	+ Support initiatives involving product, pricing, promotions, sales transactions, payments and POS integrations.
	+ Analyse Product Information Management (PIM) processes, including product data, product attributes, categorisation, enrichment, governance and distribution of product information across channels.
	+ Analyse inventory and stock management processes, including stock visibility, ordering, replenishment, wastage, stock adjustments and reconciliation.
	+ Support supply chain processes including purchasing, supplier management, product distribution and inventory movement.
	+ Understand integrations and data flows between POS, PIM, inventory, supply chain, finance, CRM and other enterprise systems.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve data quality, operational efficiency and consistency across retail and hospitality platforms.
* **Cloud, Data Platforms \& Analytics**
	+ Support cloud migration and data platform transformation programmes, including assessment of current\-state platforms, business impacts, requirements and future\-state capabilities.
	+ Work with data architects, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to define requirements for modern data platforms and data products.
	+ Analyse data flows, sources, transformations, interfaces and dependencies across retail, operational and corporate systems.
	+ Define requirements for data ingestion, transformation, storage, quality, access and consumption.
	+ Support the development of analytics, Management Information (MI), reporting, dashboards and data products that enable effective business decision\-making.
	+ Translate business and analytical needs into clear data requirements, definitions, business rules, KPIs and acceptance criteria.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve data quality, accessibility, consistency, governance and usability.
* **CRM, Customer \& Data**
	+ Define business requirements for CRM and customer\-facing capabilities.
	+ Analyse customer journeys, customer data and interactions across digital and physical channels.
	+ Support integration between CRM, POS, PIM, loyalty, marketing and other customer or operational systems.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve customer insight, personalisation, engagement and retention.
	+ Define business rules, data requirements, reporting needs and measures associated with customer and retail processes.
* **Replatforming \& Transformation**
	+ Support replatforming, platform replacement and technology transformation programmes, from discovery and current\-state assessment through to implementation and transition.
	+ Analyse the impact of moving from legacy platforms to new retail, hospitality or enterprise solutions.
	+ Define current\-state and future\-state processes, requirements, data, integrations and business impacts.
	+ Support gap analysis between existing capabilities and the target platform.

**Amaris Consulting** est une société indépendante de conseil en management et en technologie. Nous accompagnons plus de 1 000 clients à travers le monde dans la réalisation de leurs projets opérationnels et de transformation, en leur apportant notre expertise dans divers secteurs d’activité. Notre mission est de permettre à chacun de réaliser son plein potentiel et de s’épanouir professionnellement au sein d’une communauté internationale dynamique.

  


### **Description du poste :**


Vous rejoindrez Amaris Consulting en tant que **Business Analyst** pour accompagner un acteur basé à **Genève** sur des projets liés au trading, à la data et aux solutions ETRM. Dans un environnement énergie ou bancaire, vous interviendrez à l’interface entre les équipes métiers et IT afin de cadrer, analyser et sécuriser les évolutions fonctionnelles des systèmes de trading et de gestion des risques.

* Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des évolutions applicatives.
* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus trading, data et risk management.


### **À propos de vous :**


* Expérience de 7 ans minimum en business analysis, data analysis ou trading analysis, dans un environnement énergie, trading ou bancaire.
* Maîtrise des processus de trading, de gestion des risques et des systèmes ETRM.
* Connaissance des flux de données liés au trading, aux opérations, au risque et à la finance.
* Formation supérieure en finance, data, informatique, systèmes d’information ou domaine équivalent.
* Français et anglais courants obligatoire.
* Expérience dans un environnement énergie, commodities trading ou banque.
* Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques dans un contexte international.
* Rigueur, esprit de synthèse et capacité à structurer des besoins complexes.

  

### **Ce que nous offrons :**


* Une communauté internationale réunissant plus de 110 nationalités
* Un environnement où la confiance est centrale : 70 % de nos leaders ont débuté au premier niveau de responsabilités
* Un système de formation solide avec notre Academy interne et plus de 250 modules, incluant des certifications

* Jours de congé supplémentaires selon l’ancienneté
* Possibilité de télétravail selon la politique locale
* Carte restaurant adaptée au marché suisse
* Engagement fort en matière de durabilité et d’impact social via le programme WeCare Together

  

*Amaris Consulting est fier d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à promouvoir la diversité au sein de la communauté et à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. À ce titre, nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, indépendamment du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle, de l’origine, des croyances, de l’âge, de la situation familiale, du handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique.*


*\#LI\-NH2*


**Who are we?**
---------------


**Amaris Consulting** est une société indépendante de conseil et de technologies au service des entreprises. Avec plus de 1000 clients dans le monde, nous déployons des solutions pour les plus grands projets depuis plus d'une décennie \- tout ceci est rendu possible par une équipe internationale de 7,600 talents répartis sur les 5 continents et dans plus de 60 pays. Nos solutions sont axées sur quatre domaines d'activité différents : Les systèmes d'information et le digital, la télécommunication, les sciences de la vie et l'ingénierie. Nous cherchons à créer et à développer une communauté de talents où tous les membres de notre équipe peuvent réaliser leur plein potentiel. Amaris est votre « stepping stone » pour traverser les rivières du changement, pour relever les défis et pour réaliser tous vos projets avec succès.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – Job Profile

**Job Title:** Data Analyst  
**Department:** Business Intelligence / Finance / Operations  
**Location:** UAE  
**Reports To:** Finance Manager / Business Head / Management

Job Purpose

The Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, analysing, interpreting, and presenting business data to support management in making informed decisions. The role will focus on identifying trends, monitoring KPIs, preparing dashboards and reports, and providing actionable insights to improve business performance.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Data Management**

* Collect data from ERP, accounting, sales, inventory, e\-commerce and other business systems.
* Clean, validate and organize data to ensure accuracy.
* Maintain structured databases, reports and analytical files.
* Identify data inconsistencies and coordinate with relevant departments to resolve them.

**2\. Business \& Sales Analytics**

* Analyse sales by product, brand, customer, channel and region.
* Track sales targets versus actual performance.
* Identify fast\-moving and slow\-moving products.
* Analyse customer purchasing patterns and trends.
* Monitor Amazon, e\-commerce and modern\-trade performance where applicable.

**3\. Inventory \& Supply Chain Analytics**

* Monitor inventory levels and stock movements.
* Analyse stock ageing and slow\-moving inventory.
* Prepare demand and sales forecasts.
* Identify potential stock\-out and overstock situations.
* Analyse purchase, shipment and logistics data.

**4\. Financial Analytics**

* Prepare revenue, gross\-margin and profitability analysis.
* Analyse product\-level profitability.
* Monitor discounts, promotions and commercial support.
* Prepare budget versus actual reports.
* Support management with cost and margin analysis.

**5\. Dashboard \& Reporting**

* Develop daily, weekly and monthly management reports.
* Create interactive dashboards using **Power BI, Tableau or similar tools**.
* Present KPIs and trends in a clear and understandable format.
* Automate repetitive reporting wherever possible.

**6\. Data\-Driven Decision Support**

* Identify trends, opportunities and potential business risks.
* Provide insights rather than simply presenting data.
* Support management in pricing, product selection, inventory planning and sales strategy.
* Develop analytical models to support business decisions.

Required Skills

* Advanced **Microsoft Excel**
* **Power BI** or Tableau
* SQL
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence
* Statistical analysis
* Forecasting and trend analysis
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to communicate complex data in simple business terms

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in:
* Data Analytics
* Business Analytics
* Statistics
* Finance
* Economics
* Computer Science
* Business Administration

**Experience:** 2–5 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics, Sales Analytics or a similar role.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Data Analyst can be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy of reports
* Timeliness of reporting
* Dashboard automation
* Data quality
* Forecast accuracy
* Sales and margin insights
* Inventory analysis
* Reduction in manual reporting
* Quality of management recommendations

Pay: AED2,338\.89 \- AED4,500\.00 per month

Experience:

* Data analytics: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

Restaurant Supply Chain Solutions, LLC, a Yum! Brands Co\-op, is currently seeking a Program Manager II, to join the Taco Bell Concept team in Irvine, CA.

Position Overview

This position is part of the Program Management team that supports the supply chain for Taco Bell’s 8,200\+ restaurants in the U.S. with annual sales more than $18B. This role leads to complex, high\-visibility national commercialization initiatives that protect restaurant execution, franchisee experience, supply continuity, and brand performance.

To be successful in this role, Program Manager II must be a strategic, relationship\-oriented supply chain leader who can integrate project management, demand planning, financial risk management, scenario planning, and executive stakeholder communication. This person will influence cross\-functional decisions, drive launch readiness, manage risk across suppliers and distributors, and provide executive\-ready recommendations for new products, limited time offers, core menu forecasts, and strategic supply chain initiatives. * 20\-30 food, packaging and smallwares launches to support national NPI and LTOs


* $300MM\-$500MM in inventory authorizations

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**
  

  

Unio Health Partners (UHP) is a highly differentiated physician practice management platform with the goal of transforming care delivery across the Western United States. Outpatient programs provide trauma\-informed care aimed at reducing the harmful impacts of substance use. Participants and their counselors work collaboratively to design an integrated, individualized, strengths\-based treatment experience geared towards addressing each client’s specific needs and goals. Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. TPMs are expected to provide clear visibility into program status, timelines, dependencies, and escalations, and to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

  

A core focus of the role is operational execution and continuous improvement. The TPM leverages program management tools, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to improve transparency, predictability, and efficiency. #### **POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Black Infant Health (BIH) Program is meant to address the problem of poor birth outcomes and health disparities that affect African American women and their babies. The BIH program features a standard set of services that features group intervention and social service case management to help reduce stress, build resilience, promote healthy behaviors, and increase social support. The BIH Program Manager will have day to day responsibility for leadership of the BIH program and oversee all program team members and partners. This includes developing relationships with community\-based collectives, community\-based organization partners, and management of the Community Advisory Board. The position also includes management of project timelines and deliverables for timely and effective execution of the Work Plan and responsibility for project reporting. Ongoing and timely communication with Alameda County Public Health Department and other community partners will be expected as well. #### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

2\. Experience: Lived understanding of African American culture and history, and general working knowledge of family systems, community trauma, and community organizing or advocacy. 6\. Knowledge of Public Health: Demonstrates knowledge of the following: women’s health, including prenatal and postpartum health; life course perspective; infant behavior and development; health education, including breastfeeding, nutrition, and physical activity; and local community and social services.


7\. Advocacy and Outreach Skills: Essential qualifications focus on strong community engagement, population\-based assessment, and evidence\-based service delivery skills, particularly in women's health, infant behavior, health education, and addressing health inequities affecting the Black community. 8\. Interpersonal and Leadership Skills: Possess strong leadership skills. Demonstrates the organizational and interpersonal skills needed to communicate at different levels and work in complex situations. 9\. Computer Skills: Basic computer skills, and capable of using software and technology tools used to manage health data and reporting tools (Excel, Microsoft word, etc.). Experience in managing and tracking health data, navigating Epic and Tableau a plus.

1\. Program Management: Responsible for the management and coordination of local BIH program activities and staff. Maintains confidentiality and adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations. Prepares administrative, financial documents and transactions for completion, and gathers and compiles information for biannual reports.

The Sr. Fraud Program Manager is responsible for leading and maturing key components of Paze’s Fraud Program to safeguard customers and protect the integrity of the platform.

**About Upstart**


At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.


As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.


We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.


If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.


**The Team**
------------


Upstart’s Auto Retail team is bringing Upstart’s AI\-powered underwriting combined with best\-in\-class software to help all Americans get better access, lower rates and a better process when purchasing a vehicle. Auto lending represents over $600B in annual volume across over 70K dealerships and is used by almost every household in the country yet has record low process satisfaction, transparency, and credit access. We aim to change that. The team partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, Servicing, Fraud, dealer\-facing functions and more to improve the experience for lenders, dealers, and consumers.


As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own program planning, execution and outcomes for complex, high\-impact Auto Retail initiatives. You will turn ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder work into clear plans, drive decisions, manage dependencies and risks, and help teams deliver reliably and with quality. You will partner with Product Managers, who own product strategy and priorities, and Engineering Managers and engineers, who own technical design and implementation. Your leverage will come from technical judgment, cross\-functional leadership, bringing clarity from ambiguity, and the practical execution systems you build.


You’ll help accelerate the quality, speed, and adoption of the software and features we build by:


* Surfacing operational signals and customer pain points
* Analyzing problems and opportunities and developing clear, stack\-ranked recommendations
* Driving PM\-prioritized initiatives from technical planning through launch and rollout
* Establishing continuous feedback loops by monitoring post\-launch results and identifying opportunities for iteration and improvement

**How you’ll make an impact**
-----------------------------


* Lead complex, cross\-functional software initiatives from alignment through delivery, coordinating across Product, Engineering, Servicing, Analytics, Machine Learning, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and dealer\-facing partners.
* Translate ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problem spaces into actionable plans with clear milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, and owners.
* Partner with Product Managers on business strategy and prioritization, and with Engineering Managers and engineering teams on technical approaches and execution plans.
* Engage meaningfully in technical discussions by evaluating software architecture, data models, data movement, data pipelines, and trade\-offs among potential approaches.
* Identify blockers, clarify ambiguous ownership, surface downstream impacts early, and help teams resolve issues before they create delivery risk.
* Establish practical, lightweight ways of working that improve coordination and visibility across teams without creating unnecessary reporting or process overhead.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* Professional experience in a Technical Program Management role, including ownership of complex, cross\-functional software initiatives.
* Experience translating ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems into executable plans with milestones, dependencies, risks, and clear ownership.
* Experience working in a TPM or similar role directly with product managers and engineering managers and their teams with a clear understanding of ownership, roles, and responsibilities.
* Technical fluency in software architecture, data models, third party vendor integrations, and data pipelines, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs among technical approaches.
* Experience delivering initiatives across Product and Engineering while connecting program execution to measurable business or customer outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience working in a complex industry, a multi\-sided marketplace, or B2B2C environment with competing stakeholders and priorities such as speed, quality, reliability, and scale.
* Experience partnering with teams in financial services, auto retail, servicing, fraud, analytics, Machine Learning, or other operationally complex domains.
* Experience establishing and scaling practical program\-management processes in an environment where ownership and ways of working are still evolving.
* Experience in a growth\-stage technology company or other environment where teams must move quickly while managing execution risk.

Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. **More about our team and company:**

  
**The Opportunity**
===================



We’re looking for a versatile Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who enjoys connecting the details to the bigger business picture. You’ll own sales compensation and tackle a range of other analytical and operational challenges that help Fleetio’s go\-to\-market teams perform at their best.



You’ll run the monthly commission process, maintain accurate plans, and help our teams understand and trust their payouts. Alongside that ownership, you’ll analyze performance trends, strengthen reporting, and improve the processes that support our revenue organization.



You might trace a commission discrepancy back to its source, investigate why conversion changed across a sales segment, or turn a manual workflow into a repeatable process using automation. You’ll identify problems, recommend solutions, and work with partners to implement those improvements.



This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives on variety, takes pride in precise execution, and wants to build both deep expertise and broad business understanding. You’re curious about how things work, comfortable learning unfamiliar processes, and motivated by making them better.

In this position, the Social Science Research Analyst will support federal staff with managing activities supported by the welfare and family self\-sufficiency research and evaluation portfolio. This portfolio is designed to expand knowledge about how Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) and other human services programs can best support the self\-sufficiency and economic well\-being of children and families with low incomes. Research, evaluation, data, and other activities within this portfolio advance the objectives of the statute authorizing this work and cover a range of topics including TANF policy and administration, evaluation capacity building within human services programs, employment attainment and retention, and knowledge building and communication. The portfolio includes experimental impact evaluations, implementation evaluations, descriptive research projects, research and data\-focused technical assistance projects, and other activities aimed at informing the design and implementation of programs.



In this position, the Social Science Research Analyst will use knowledge of TANF and other human services programs, research and evaluation methodology, data analysis, and statistics to assist federal staff in communicating with and monitoring the work of grantees and contractors; and coordinating research, evaluation, data\-related, and other activities.


**Responsibilities:**



* Support federal staff in managing research contracts and grants from award through project completion, report approval, and dissemination of findings, including:
	+ Reviewing contractor deliverables, such as reports, work plans, and analysis plans.
	+ Assisting with project management activities, including invoice review, timeline monitoring, action item tracking, and records management.
	+ Reviewing and processing grant actions, including performance progress reports, amendments, and noncompeting continuation applications.
* Monitor emerging research and trends relevant to ACF programs to:
	+ Support the integration of research findings into ongoing projects and strategic planning efforts.
	+ Identify emerging issues, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for future research, synthesis, and analysis.
* Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with OFA and ACF staff, leadership, program offices, and external stakeholders to ensure research, evaluation, and data activities align with program priorities and field needs.
* Facilitate the communication and dissemination of welfare and family self\-sufficiency research by:
	+ Providing written and verbal updates, coordinating meetings, preparing briefing materials and presentations, and participating in conferences and professional convenings.
	+ Fostering collaboration among grantees, contractors, researchers, and federal staff to promote the exchange of research findings, methodologies, and measurement approaches.
	+ Developing position papers, issue analyses, briefing materials, fact sheets, and other written products related to data, research findings, and program operations.
* Provide subject matter expertise to OFA and other ACF program offices in research methodology, data and policy analysis, performance management, program evaluation design and oversight, and applied research.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
 **Qualifications:**


* Demonstrated knowledge of policies and programs affecting children and families served by ACF programs, particularly TANF and other human services programs that seek to foster employment and economic well\-being among families with low incomes.
* Demonstrated knowledge of advanced social science statistical methods and techniques for assessing and improving the implementation and effectiveness of policies, programs, and interventions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with regard to (1\) critiquing empirical reports for technical accuracy and to improve clarity, and (2\) explaining complex evaluation, statistical, and data analysis methodologies and findings to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment, and be flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams).
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
* U.S. Citizenship required

  


**Education and Experience:**


* Master’s degree in Child and Family Studies, Economics, Human Development, Psychology, Political Science, Public Health, Public Policy, Social Work, Sociology, or related fields required.
* Three (3\) or more years’ experience with program evaluation, research and evaluation designs, qualitative and/or quantitative data collection and analysis, and program performance measurement, with specific expertise in research, programs, and policies related to one or more focus areas within the welfare and family self\-sufficiency research and evaluation portfolio.

new_jobs.description:
Join our Deloitte AI \& Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Project Lead Integration Engineer II on the project, provide critical Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) and Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) planning, coordination, and intelligence\-integration. The role ensures the security and resilience of the theater supply chain by identifying, assessing, and mitigating vendor\-related risks\-including foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI), cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial exploitation\-across the Area of Responsibility (AOR). The role is highly dynamic and adaptive to command priorities; requiring an experienced professional who can operate independently with minimal guidance.  

  

The VTM Program Analyst serves as a key contractor supporting Geographic Combatant Command (GCC) secure logistics objectives. The role focuses on the strategic planning of vendor threat assessments and supply chain illumination, aligned with the Theater Campaign Plan, Posture Plan, and Department of Defense (DoD) SCRM directives. A primary requirement is the ability to conduct high\-level risk framework analysis and all\-source intelligence reports, integrate them for mitigation actions into major joint operations, exercise support, and coalition logistics. As required, forward adversarial findings and reports to respective procurement contracting agencies and associated authorities to take direct action against vendor threats. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to successfully collaborate in multi\-echelon Joint Logistics and Intelligence Enterprises (JLEnt/JIE), are mandatory for success in this role.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* **Threat Analysis \& Illumination:** Conduct rigorous supply chain illuminations and vendor threat assessments to identify FOCI, cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial influence risks within the AOR, ensuring mission requirements are protected from compromised suppliers
* **Mitigation Planning:** Develop and implement theater\-specific VTM mitigation strategies and risk response plans, ensuring alignment with DoD security protocols and mission\-critical function protection
* **Exercise \& Operation Integration:** Support VTM planning for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Exercises (e.g., Balikatan, Cobra Gold), ensuring theater supply chains are modeled, stress\-tested against subversion, and assessed during major training events
* **Interagency \& Partner Sync:** Synchronize vendor threat intelligence and mitigation strategies with USFK, USFJ, SOCPAC, and regional Service Components. Coordinate with DCSA, DLA, and USTRANSCOM to ensure a unified theater defense
* **Governance \& Reporting**: Serve as a subject matter expert for VTM policy and governance. Draft formal staff products (EXSUMs, Info Papers) and deliver executive\-level briefings to General/Flag Officers (GO/FO) regarding theater supply chain vulnerabilities.
* **Doctrine \& Planning Proficiency:** Deeply understand and apply the following Joint Publications (JPs), DoD Directives and Instructions (DoDD/DoDI), and associated policies that support theater distribution security and vendor threat mitigation:
* + DoDD 5000\.01, The Defense Acquisition System: Mandates supply chain risk management, security, and resilience throughout the acquisition lifecycle and sustainment operations.
	+ DoDD 5240\.02, Counterintelligence (CI): Establishes foundational CI policy essential for identifying and mitigating foreign intelligence threats, FOCI, and espionage within the vendor base.
	+ DoDI 5200\.44: Protection of Mission Critical Functions to Achieve Trusted Systems and Networks (TSN).
	+ DoDI 4140\.01: DoD Supply Chain Materiel Management Policy (with focus on SCRM and resilience).
	+ DoDI 5000\.90: Cybersecurity for Acquisition Decision Authorities and Program Managers.
	+ JP 4\-0 / JP 4\-01: Joint Logistics and the Joint Deployment and Distribution Enterprise (JDDE).
	+ JP 4\-10, Operational Contract Support (OCS): Integration of commercial support into joint operations, including the assessment of vendor\-related risks to force protection and mission assurance.
	+ JP 2\-0 / JP 3\-0: Joint Intelligence and Joint Operations integration for threat\-informed logistics.
	+ NDAA Compliance: Specific expertise in Sections 889 (telecommunications) and 5949 (semiconductors) prohibitions within theater of operations.

  

**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Program Manager**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Training Systems and Simulation Program Management Office (PMO) in the development, delivery, operation, and maintenance of all F\-35 training systems, to include all Pilot Training Devices, Maintenance Training Devices, and the Joint Simulation


Environment. The F\-35 Training Systems are critical enablers to producing Mission Qualified Pilots and Maintainers while tracking their training status throughout the individuals’ career. They are comprised of the Hardware, Software, subsystems, equipment, and reference data required to design, develop, deliver, evaluate, and refine the training provided to F\-35 personnel with the necessary capacity and fidelity to enable aircrews to train to the high\-end fight.

  

You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who work closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.

  



**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security clearance.**


In this role you will:


* Pilot and Maintenance Training Devices – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in overseeing the development and delivery of all Pilot Training Devices and Maintenance Training Devices, and in exploring future technology solutions that could potentially resolve existing technology limits within the training systems.
* Pilot and Maintenance Training Courseware – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in producing the courseware used for classroom training as a supplement to the Pilot and Maintenance Training Devices.
* Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in managing three subsystems as part of the LVC architecture.
* Verification and Validation – assist Training Systems and Simulation PMO in performing verification and validation as part of the development and acceptance of the Training Products (devices, courseware, training aids, etc.) prior to delivery to the customer.

* IPT/stakeholders through Request for Proposal (RFP) package development and Proposal Evaluation. Communicate TSS PMO needs with the prime contractor. Review and evaluate both RFP and proposal information and make recommendations to the team. Ensure teams meet deadlines to reduce contract lead times. Organize, record and track contract information changes and communications between contractors and the TSS PMO team. Create products and presentations that present information logically and increase team knowledge. Ensure contract status is updated weekly.
* Assist with task support of acquisitions, financial management, risk management, systems engineering, total ownership cost determination, acquisition coordination, and communications.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) located at Crystal City, VA, a minimum of 3 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst,** F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.


You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role, you will:


* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross\-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F\-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F\-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - TS/SCI
new_jobs.description:
Spry Methods is seeking a Technical Program Manager to provide leadership and technical oversight for personnel supporting cyber intelligence analysis, operational enablement, and related mission activities. The Technical Lead will assign work, supervise technical efforts, manage team performance, and ensure the quality and efficiency of contract performance. This position will support intelligence collection, all\-source cyber analysis, analytical production, knowledge management, technology integration, external engagement, and cyber operations. The Technical Lead will also support applicable financial and business processes while avoiding inherently governmental functions. Occasional CONUS and OCONUS travel is required



### **What Your Day\-To\-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities):**


* Provide leadership and technical guidance to personnel supporting mission activities.
* Assign tasks, supervise ongoing technical efforts, and manage overall team performance.
* Ensure analytical products and technical deliverables are accurate, complete, objective, timely, and compliant with quality standards.
* Oversee all\-source cyber analysis supporting law enforcement, counterintelligence investigations, and cyber operations.
* Guide the development of intelligence requirements and methodologies for collecting, analyzing, managing, and presenting intelligence.
* Support the production and quality review of serialized intelligence products, operational cyber threat products, Intelligence Information Reports, cyber intelligence reports, operational lead reports, and related analytical products.
* Coordinate intelligence analysis and operational planning with Government personnel, intelligence analysts, and mission partners.
* Support intelligence collection and analysis using multiple intelligence disciplines, including HUMINT and SIGINT methodologies.
* Lead technical exchanges, working groups, liaison activities, and information\-sharing efforts with mission partners.
* Manage technical project scope, schedules, resources, costs, risks, and performance.
* Support requirements and capability assessments, production metrics, executive briefings, and actionable recommendations.
* Coordinate rapid technical and analytical support for emerging cyber mission requirements.
* Assist with applicable financial and business processes without performing inherently governmental functions.
* Travel occasionally to CONUS and OCONUS locations.
### **What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements):**


* TS/SCI clearance eligibility.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years leading technical efforts or supervising teams supporting intelligence analysis requirements.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years supporting the Intelligence Community or related Government, industry, or academic organizations in intelligence collection, policy, systems, and capabilities.
* Minimum of seven years of experience within the last ten years applying intelligence analysis principles, concepts, and methodologies, including HUMINT and SIGINT methods.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years developing requirements and methodologies to collect, analyze, manage, and present intelligence in support of cyber investigations and operations.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years producing analytical reports, including Intelligence Information Reports, serialized intelligence products, and operational cyber threat products.
* Minimum of five years of experience within the last ten years managing project scope, cost, resources, risk, and schedule.
### **Ideally, You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications):**


* Experience supporting DoW law enforcement, counterintelligence, or cyber operations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary intelligence and technical teams.
* Experience reviewing serialized intelligence and all\-source cyber products for quality and compliance.
* Experience coordinating with Intelligence Community, law enforcement, counterintelligence, and interagency mission partners.
* Familiarity with cyber threat intelligence, intelligence collection management, technical capability assessments, and operational planning.
$200,000 \- $210,000 a year
Final compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, certifications, clearance level, and contract requirements. This position is contingent upon contract award.

new_jobs.title: Logistics Security Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


The Logistics Security Intelligence Analyst supports Micron’s global logistics security program by producing timely, actionable intelligence on shipment risk, cargo theft trends, route exposure, carrier performance, alert activity, and logistics security incidents. This individual contributor role helps strengthen shipment visibility, support incident response, and enable data\-driven decisions for valuable and sensitive shipments across Micron’s transportation network.  



  

**Responsibilities:**

* Collect, analyze, and report on logistics security data related to high\-value and high\-risk shipments, including shipment value, route risk, carrier performance, tracking status, alert activity, and incident history.
* Monitor internal, vendor, industry, open\-source, and law\-enforcement sources for cargo theft trends, route disruptions, regional security developments, and emerging threats.
* Prepare intelligence summaries, dashboards, route profiles, regional threat updates, incident trend reports, and briefing materials for logistics security leaders and multi\-functional collaborators.
* Support lane, route, carrier, provider, and regional risk assessments by identifying risk indicators, documenting findings, and helping translate analysis into practical control recommendations.
* Analyze shipment monitoring alerts such as route deviation, unauthorized stop, signal loss, seal breach, geofence violation, cargo separation, and other logistics security events.
* Support blocking issue and incident response activities by validating information, compiling shipment and carrier details, maintaining incident timelines, and contributing to after\-action reviews.
* Maintain structured records of incidents, near misses, alerts, carrier exceptions, recovery outcomes, false positives, device failures, and corrective actions to support program metrics and continuous improvement.
* Assist with logistics security playbooks, standard operating procedures, reporting templates, risk assessment criteria, audit support materials, and governance documentation.
* Use data analytics, AI\-enabled tools, mapping resources, shipment visibility platforms, and intelligence databases to support efficient, well\-governed logistics risk analysis.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Security, Risk Management, Business, Data Analytics, Intelligence Studies, or a related field.
* Experience supporting logistics security, transportation risk, supply chain risk, intelligence analysis, investigations, or related risk management functions.
* Collect, analyze, and synthesize operational, security, shipment, carrier, and incident data to identify trends and support decision\-making.
* Solid understanding of logistics operations, transportation networks, cargo movement, carrier management, supply chain security, and data visualization/reporting tools.
* Prepare business\-focused reports and risk assessments, collaborate across functions, and manage sensitive logistics and security information with discretion.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in supply chain security, logistics, intelligence analysis, risk management, or related disciplines, with relevant certifications/training (e.g., TAPA, CTPAT).
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess and communicate logistics security risks in clear business terms.
* Diligent with the ability to maintain accurate records, reports, documentation, and timelines in fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environments.
* Collaborate with multi\-functional teams, logistics partners, carriers, security vendors, and internal collaborators.
* Demonstrated sound judgment, confidentiality, and proficiency with AI\-enabled, data\-driven, and automation tools to improve analysis, reporting, and decision\-making.

**Description**


**Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?**

  

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. The Leidos Intelligence Sector combines technology\-enabled services and mission software capabilities in the areas of cyber, logistics, security operations, and decision analytics to support our defense and intel customers’ mission to defend against evolving threats around the world.

 **Your greatest work is ahead!**

  

The Intelligence Sector seeks a highly qualified and trained Journeyman\-level Cyberspace Intelligence Threat Analysts to support United States Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM) operations, with focus on identifying, analyzing, and recommending mitigation strategies for Cyber threats targeting Offensive Cyberspace Operations (OCO) systems. This vital on\-site support to USCYBERCOM J3 (Operations), Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF), and Joint Task Force\-Ares (JTF\-ARES) underpins USCYBERCOM support to United States National Security objectives.

  

This opportunity is in anticipation of a potential future contract award.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Provide timely, accurate, relevant support in manner that best supports USCYBERCOM in identifying and assessing emerging threats and vulnerabilities in the Cyberspace domain, with focus on risks to OCO systems.
* Analyze and evaluate All\-Source finished intelligence, single\-source intelligence, and technical data from various sources to identify Cyber threat patterns and anomalies.
* Produce and deliver recurring threat intelligence reports, summarizing relevant cyber threats to OCO infrastructure.
* Conduct and publish in\-depth risk assessments to evaluate and categorize the risk posture of detected cyber threats while supporting development and refinement of risk assessment methodologies and tools used for threat categorization.
* Utilize Signals Intelligence (SIGINT) tools and apply analytical methodologies when required to perform technical analysis on critical Cyber threats impacting OCO assets.
* Collaborate with operational, technical, and intelligence elements across USCYBERCOM to enhance situational awareness and threat response capabilities.
* Maintain a current understanding of advanced persistent threats (APTs), threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and cyber threat trends affecting national security.
* Maintain situational awareness of, and execute on demand, Cyberspace Operations (CO) crisis plans.
* Provide situational awareness to a range of projects, Crisis Action Teams, and current operations activities supporting Operational Planning Teams (OPTs).
* Execute resource allocation decisions aligned with organization objectives.
* Apply knowledge of cyber threats and attack methods and techniques emanating from state and non\-state adversaries and tiered vulnerabilities within Blue Space as focus of threats.
* Develop and execute comprehensive programs for assessing CO and validating operational performance characteristics.
* Review, approve, prioritize, and submit operational requirements for research, development, and/or acquisition of cyber capabilities.
* Support integration and synchronization of intelligence planning activities with operational planning timelines.
* Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, and guidance relevant to daily activities.
* Communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well\-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

 **What does Leidos need from me?**

* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and Polygraph required.
* BA/BS degree or higher within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Intelligence Studies, or related field, or ability to complete degree within one year of hire. Can substitute formal education with extended experience and technical certifications.
* Five plus years’ experience within Cyber intelligence analysis or a similar Cyber threat analyst role, or eight plus years’ total within field of intelligence analysis.
* Demonstrated understanding of All\-Source intelligence principles as applied to field of Cyber.
* Demonstrated experience with applicable SIGINT tools and techniques and able to produce single\-source intelligence products tailored to drive CO.
* Broad knowledge of Blue\-space Cyber capabilities and demonstrate understanding of available Cyber infrastructure or platforms to conduct Defensive (DCO) and Offensive Cyberspace Operations (OCO).
* Knowledge of the range of CO and their underlying intelligence support needs, topics, and focus areas.
* Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as well as concepts, terminology, and operations of a wide range of communications media (computer and telephone networks, satellite, fiber, wireless).
* Ability to support timely, accurate, relevant analytical production, to include documents, summaries, issue papers, talking points, and briefings
* Demonstrated proficiency working in a fast\-paced collaborative environment, ability to proactively multi\-task and meet short deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal, critical thinking, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex and technical data to non\-technical consumers.

 **Favorable if you have:**

* Masters’ Degree or higher within Cybersecurity, Intelligence Studies, Information Security or related fields.
* Intimate familiarity with USCYBERCOM organizational structure and mission.
* Prior experience supporting Joint operations across multiple warfighting domains.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning into operations at any level to increase efficiency and effectiveness of operational outcomes
